title: Transfer Learning in Earth Observation Data Analysis: A review

authors.affiliation: ESRIN - ESA Centre for Earth Observation
Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation
ESRIN - ESA Centre for Earth Observation

abstract: The significant increase in the amount of satellite data in recent years along with the increase in computing resources has opened up new possibilities for Earth Observation (EO) data analysis. However, the main obstacle to obtaining highquality products is the limited amount of labeled data. Among the methods that can help solve this type of problem, transfer learning (TL) has gained enormous interest in recent years. It involves using a model trained on one problem to solve another problem. This article reviews TL methods as applied to EO data analyses. It provides a structured overview of methods in relation to applications, publication statistics, and summarizes the advantages and disadvantages noted of previous research.
